body: {"better": "A", "reason": "Card B uses imperative forms (నడవండి, చూడండి) which are commanding and disrespectful to a mother; Card A uses natural descriptive forms (నడకతో చేరుకోవచ్చు, చూడవచ్చు) that are warm and respectful. Also Card B lacks a reason they'd enjoy it, while Card A gives one (అందమైన కాంచలు)."}
